items.headline: $IRIS Brings Fixed-Rate Borrowing to SparkLend Today
items.summary: $IRIS goes live Nov. 10 with fixed-rate loans on SparkLend, letting borrowers set custom durations while solvers post capital to absorb rate gaps.

items.headline: Kinetiq Launches Elysium Mainnet on $HYPE
items.summary: Kinetiq's Elysium mainnet is live for $HYPE, with Pump.fun and Fomo enabling trading; native HyperCore reads and fast order submissions come later.

items.headline: PeckShield Links $45M ETH Long to $UXLINK Exploit
items.summary: PeckShield flagged a $45.3M ETH long possibly tied to the $UXLINK exploiter; a later snapshot showed ~$44M exposure and a $652K unrealized loss.

items.headline: $ANKR Bridge Drained $303K in Five Transactions
items.summary: $ANKR's Ethereum bridge lost over $303K across five transactions after withdrawals reused an already-redeemed Optimism deposit; the contract stayed unpaused.

items.headline: NYSE Taps $AVAX for 24/7 Tokenized Stock Settlement
items.summary: NYSE chose $AVAX to power clearing for its tokenized-securities venue, targeting instant settlement and stablecoin funding pending regulatory approval.
